jobs.title: CRM Business Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY (Financial District); hybrid, in office Tuesday–Thursday, remote Monday and Friday
jobs.salary: $115,000–$125,000 base; no bonus; fully meets Audrey's ~$100K target
jobs.why: Strong Salesforce/Business Systems match. Role requests Salesforce CRM analysis, requirements and user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, reporting/dashboard governance, testing, training, documentation, stakeholder alignment and workflow optimization. Audrey has demonstrated these through Orion's Salesforce contract-request Flow, Visio mapping, UAT coordination, Salesforce Knowledge training and 10+ years of CRM data cleanup, plus Horizon Blue ABA workflow automation. Her prior media reporting and marketing-adjacent work adds relevant context.
jobs.gap: No verified HubSpot administration or direct ownership of marketing campaign segmentation, nurturing and conversion funnels; no independent CRM platform roadmap ownership. Employer asks 3–5 years in CRM/related analyst roles, while Audrey has roughly 2 years 4 months of Orion Salesforce BA experience plus overlapping Horizon Blue ABA systems work; eligibility may depend on how related experience is counted.
